description.en: Starts a match-side cutscene ("soccer event") if a match is currently active: marks the active-event state, and for the upper display side also swaps the normal match map for the technique map and creates a temporary goal-post model, storing the swapped handles into the given output array.
Whether the cutscene runs on the "upper" display side.
Output array; filled with [normalMapHandle, wazaMapHandle, goalModelHandle] when _is_upper is set.
Optional; whether the temporary goal model casts a shadow (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value when no match is active) — implicitly null.
